name: NGINX
tagline: Event-driven edge proxy: terminates TLS, routes HTTP and balances raw TCP and UDP.

howItWorks.title: Processes
howItWorks.body:
The master reads config and binds ports.
Workers run a non-blocking event loop.
Reload starts new workers and drains the old ones.
No connection drops during a reload.

howItWorks.title: HTTP at L7
howItWorks.body:
server blocks match listen port and server_name.
location blocks match the URI.
proxy_pass sends to an upstream pool.
keepalive reuses upstream connections.

howItWorks.title: TLS termination
howItWorks.body:
ssl_certificate and ssl_certificate_key load the cert.
ssl_protocols limits to TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3.
A shared session cache resumes handshakes cheaply.
Backends receive plain HTTP, or re-encrypt with proxy_ssl.

howItWorks.title: Client IP preservation
howItWorks.body:
A balancer in front sends the PROXY protocol header.
listen ... proxy_protocol accepts it.
set_real_ip_from trusts the balancer address only.
real_ip_header proxy_protocol sets $remote_addr to the client.

howItWorks.title: Stream at L4
howItWorks.body:
The stream block proxies TCP and UDP without parsing them.
listen and proxy_pass pick the port and upstream.
proxy_protocol on forwards the client address to the backend.
Use it for PostgreSQL, SMTP or DNS.

flow: Client resolves the name and connects to the VIP.
keepalived places the VIP on the active node.
NGINX accepts the connection and reads the PROXY header.
realip restores the client address from the trusted source.
TLS terminates; server_name and location select the route.
proxy_pass picks an upstream peer and reuses keepalive.
The stream block forwards raw TCP to non-HTTP backends.
access_log and stub_status expose the result.

deploy.summary: On-prem edge VM: hardened host, static address, firewall, NGINX with TLS, PROXY protocol and stream.
prerequisites: Debian or Ubuntu VM with sudo
A DNS name and a static address

steps.title: SSH key and sshd hardening
steps.code:
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "ops@edge"
ssh-copy-id -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub ops@EDGE_HOST
sudo tee /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-hardening.conf <<'EOF'
PermitRootLogin no
PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
AllowUsers ops
EOF
sudo sshd -t && sudo systemctl reload ssh
steps.note: Replace ops and EDGE_HOST. Keep a second session open until key login works.

steps.title: Static address and DNS
steps.code:
# /etc/netplan/01-edge.yaml
network:
  version: 2
  ethernets:
    ens18:
      addresses: [10.0.10.11/24]
      routes:
        - to: default
          via: 10.0.10.1
      nameservers:
        addresses: [10.0.10.2]
steps.note: Replace the interface and addresses, then run sudo netplan apply. Add the A record for example.test.

steps.title: Firewall rules
steps.code:
sudo ufw default deny incoming
sudo ufw allow from ADMIN_CIDR to any port 22 proto tcp
sudo ufw allow 443/tcp
sudo ufw allow from LB_ADDR to any port 8080,15432 proto tcp
sudo ufw enable
steps.note: Replace ADMIN_CIDR and LB_ADDR. Backends never face the internet.

steps.title: Install NGINX and the stream module
steps.code:
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y nginx libnginx-mod-stream
sudo mkdir -p /etc/nginx/certs /etc/nginx/stream.d
steps.note: On RHEL-family use dnf install nginx. Check nginx -V for stream support.

verify: nginx -t reports syntax is ok and test is successful
tail /var/log/nginx/access.log shows the real client IP
psql -h EDGE_HOST -p 15432 connects through the stream proxy
pitfalls: No proxy_http_version 1.1 and empty Connection means no upstream keepalive.
proxy_set_header in a location replaces every inherited header from the server.
proxy_pass http://app/ versus http://app rewrites the URI differently.
listen proxy_protocol without set_real_ip_from shows the balancer, not the client.
A hostname in proxy_pass resolves once at startup; use a resolver and variable.
Open source NGINX has no active health checks; failed requests mark peers down.
Low worker_connections or file limits log 'Too many open files' under load.
keyPoints: NGINX listens on HTTP and stream; one master supervises event-loop workers.
The http block routes by Host and path; the stream block proxies TCP and UDP.
TLS terminates at NGINX; proxy_protocol and realip keep the client IP.
nginx -t, then reload: new workers start, old ones drain.
quickDeploy: Harden SSH, set a static address and open ports.
Write nginx.conf with http, TLS and stream blocks.
Run nginx -t, then start under systemd.
Reload gracefully and watch stub_status and logs.
osiNote: Terminates TLS and routes by Host and path; stream proxies TCP.
production: Set worker_rlimit_nofile and LimitNOFILE; size worker_connections for peak sockets.
Pair two nodes with keepalived VRRP for a floating VIP.
Keep configs in Git; roll back by restoring the file and reloading.
Allow TLSv1.2 and 1.3 only; protect keys with mode 600.
Scrape stub_status and alert on 5xx rate and upstream response time p95.
